items.source: This annotation has no effect on the actual binding process, but serves as a hint to the spring-boot-configuration-processor to generate full metadata for the type.
items.translation: 此注解对实际的绑定过程没有影响，但作为提示供 spring-boot-configuration-processor` 为该类型生成完整的元数据。

items.source: Typically, this annotation is only required for types located in a different module than the @ConfigurationProperties class that references them. When both types are in the same module, the annotation processor can automatically discover full metadata as long as the source is available.
items.translation: 通常，此注解仅对位于引用它们的 <code>@ConfigurationProperties` 类所在模块之外的类型是必需的。当两个类型都在同一模块中时，只要源代码可用，注解处理器即可自动发现完整元数据。
